config.purpose: Matched dual-stream capacity control for R02. Keep the complete R02 architecture and training protocol, but replace the DSM stream with a fixed one-channel grayscale derived from the same Optical RGB input. Tests whether R02 clean gain is DSM-specific or explained by dual-stream capacity/structure.

schedule.note: Fresh-from-initialization complete 16k schedule. Warmup remains 1200 so the intended experimental change versus the 12k pilot is the decay horizon, not the warmup duration.

validation.note: Validation uses VAL2 only. Historical TEST6 is not touched during training.

decision_rule.primary: Compare the VAL2 NB mIoU_fg5 trajectory of this fresh complete 16k schedule against the completed 12k pilot.
decision_rule.accept_16k: Freeze 16k for formal R01-R04 if the late 13k-16k region is stable/plateaued and no sustained endpoint improvement remains.
decision_rule.reconsider: If the best region still sits at the 16k endpoint with material late improvement, reassess the schedule once more rather than extending this run in-place.

split.selection_rule: Start from the historical Potsdam Train18 list. Use Python random.Random(20260915).sample(TRAIN18, 2), then sort the selected IDs. No labels, validation metrics, TEST6 metrics, or model outputs were inspected when choosing the two validation tiles.

policy.note: TEST6 has already influenced prior model development and is development/historical evidence, not an honest sealed final test.
